fact: NIR Executive Director Andrew Peters told a press conference in August that all data of the national ID scheme will be stored within Liberia and that OeSD will not be allowed to control it.

Registry director Andrew Peters says the signed OeSD International concession, a build-operate-transfer deal worth about US$54.7 million, does not hand ownership of identity data to the company and includes training and technology transfer; implementation awaits legislative rectification.
